subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five public memory role slots with per-agent overrides as the permanent plugin contract, and if so should legacy `plugins.slots.memory` be migrated before runtime rather than retained as a live alias?
rationale: The PR creates durable public config and plugin API surface; repository policy requires one canonical runtime path, while the linked RFC and discussion contain no confirmed maintainer decision on taxonomy or compatibility duration.

options.title: Adopt canonical roles only
options.body: Approve the named role architecture, remove steady-state legacy fallback, and limit per-agent keys to roles with agent-scoped invocation routing.

options.title: Approve a compatibility window
options.body: Keep the legacy runtime alias for a documented period with focused compatibility tests, ecosystem guidance, and a removal plan.

options.title: Pause the role API
options.body: Keep the PR open but pause landing until the RFC settles role taxonomy, invocation contracts, and migration policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical roles only
recommendation.body: Approve the named role architecture, remove steady-state legacy fallback, and limit per-agent keys to roles with agent-scoped invocation routing.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history identifies this person as the introducer of the existing slot implementation and the strongest available owner for the public plugin/config decision.
